products.name: Eightfold AI
products.note: Talent intelligence platform; skills matching; DEI bias risk; high-stakes employment decisions

profile_text.body:
Eightfold is a Mountain View, California company that describes itself as an agentic talent intelligence platform aimed at HR leaders. Its site says the platform is designed to help businesses find, screen, and hire candidates across recruiting and talent management, with an emphasis on high-volume hiring scenarios where a single role may attract hundreds of applicants. The company characterizes its approach as keeping human recruiters in the decision seat, stating that its AI supports and informs but does not itself decide on candidates.

The core product, tracked under the category of HR and Talent AI, is the Eightfold AI platform, which includes a feature called AI Interviewer that conducts candidate interviews and produces summaries for recruiters. The site claims some customers have reduced time-to-fill by 33 percent and filled roles in as little as 1.3 days. Eightfold also describes what it calls the world's first AI management standard, presenting third-party auditing of its AI Interviewer for bias as a distinguishing feature, with results said to be publicly available.

The held facts note 161 legal cases with California exposure, which is consistent with the company's headquarters in Mountain View. The product record flags skills matching, DEI bias risk, and high-stakes employment decisions as relevant characteristics of the platform, reflecting the regulatory and fairness considerations that commonly attach to AI used in hiring contexts.
